scope: Case report that states a four-part classification of diffuse alveolar haemorrhage without systemic vasculitis.

keyRecommendations.text: DAH without systemic vasculitis is divided into limited anti-GBM disease, pulmonary-limited MPA, isolated pauci-immune pulmonary capillaritis, and idiopathic pulmonary haemosiderosis.
Isolated pauci-immune pulmonary capillaritis is ANCA-negative neutrophilic capillaritis.

clinicalBottomLine: When DAH has no systemic vasculitis, the classification in this paper separates limited anti-GBM disease, lung-limited MPA, ANCA-negative pauci-immune capillaritis, and idiopathic pulmonary haemosiderosis.
notableCaveats: This is a case report plus a classification paragraph, not a guideline. The single case is not used as the natural history.
